name: High protein yogurt
identity: Chilled high-protein yogurt or milk-protein dessert of the supermarket cup, 10 to 12 g protein per 100 g; always flavoured.
rule: Per 100 g, each value is the median of the three labels below that declare it, and a value enters only when at least three labels declare it (flavoured by nature). Salt becomes sodium (salt in g × 400 = sodium in mg). Nothing a label leaves out becomes zero. Labels read on 2026-10-30 from Open Food Facts through Akari's proxy, as the beef protein isolate was.

labels.ingredients: skimmed milk, milk protein, 5,2% strawberries, 1,3% strawberry juice from concentrate, maize starch, beetroot juice concentrate, sweeteners: erythritol, sucralose, yogurt cultures (milk), lactase, natural flavouring,
Quark (milk) 89%, strawberries 5%, sugar, water, corn flour, natural flavourings, acid (citric acid), concentrates (carrot, safflower)
